Priya (CSM): Quick sync — Meridian asked for a short SLO summary + a clear credit worked example for finance. Go-live Friday. Can SRE/Eng/Enablement collate?
Liam (SRE): Yep. Contract: 99.5% monthly availability, p95 < 300ms per route (UTC day). I'll pull 30d availability and flag days <99.3%.
Jordan (Eng): I'll export route-level p95 + per-region breakdown and note any automatic fallbacks that affect tail latency.
Ravi (Enablement): I'll make a one-pager + FAQ. Need a plain-language credit example showing math for availability 99.2% over a 30-day period.
Priya (CSM): Legal defines downtime as any continuous window >=5m where availability < target. Please ensure we use UTC rollover.
Liam (SRE): Simple calc I'll add to the doc: 30 days = 43,200 minutes. Target allowed downtime = 0.5% * 43,200 = 216 minutes. Observed downtime for 99.2% = 0.8% * 43,200 = 345.6 minutes. Minutes below target = 129.6. Credit% = minutes_below / total_minutes => 129.6 / 43,200 ≈ 0.3%. Apply to invoice, subject to contract cap (bizops to confirm cap).
Jordan (Eng): Note on fallbacks: when primary model pool is saturated we route to a compatible replica — adds ~30-50ms tail for some requests. We'll mark those traces so customers can see fallbacks in the console.
Ravi (Enablement): Draft wording for the customer: "If monthly availability falls below 99.5%, we calculate the minutes below target and issue a credit equal to that fraction of the monthly bill, up to the contractual cap. Example: 99.2% availability over 30 days → ~0.3% credit." I'll leave the cap placeholder.
ops-bot: KB link: https://console.redwood.com/kb/slo-crediting (auto)
Priya (CSM): Timeline: raw exports today, one-pager draft by tomorrow AM, final before the Friday call. Liam/Jordan please drop CSV/JSON in onboarding evidence folder and flag any anomalies >0.2% deviation.
Liam (SRE): Will do. Found one signal: 2024-01-12 us-west ~12m dip (~0.4%) — I'll include a short RCA note.
Jordan (Eng): I'll attach p95 JSON and a short sentence about how we measure p95 per route (UTC day) and whether fallback events are included.
Priya (CSM): Thanks team — once artifacts are in I will package and send to the customer.
